Two further checks on the same open item (docs 40746/44555, see prior entry). (1) Shell/CYL contamination ruled out: per docs/governance/sku_suffix_mapping.md (.1-suffix SKUs are the brand-neutral cylinder deposit 'shell asset' and must be stripped from the LPG ledger), recomputed is_lpg=True-only totals directly from invoices.csv for all 4 candidate months (2025-06, 2025-07, 2025-12, 2026-03) -- all match monthly_lpg_insights.csv exactly to the cent, and every invoice line under both payments' target docs is a pure gas-content line with no mixed-in deposit line. (2) Corrected an overstatement in the prior entry: payment 39812's UNALLOCATED_PORTION tag is routine (32 of 78 payments carry it across all 9 years, several already ratified), not a unique anomaly. What is genuinely unusual is that 39812 and doc 38846 (R27,895.66 combined, 2025-05/06) have no month assignment at all in monthly_lpg_insights.csv, unlike those ratified cases -- flagged as the most promising unexplored thread for resolving the dispute, alongside April/May 2025 both showing fully UNPAID. Report SS5 updated with both findings; verdict remains UNRESOLVED.

Resolved the 38846/39812 thread flagged in the prior entry. An exhaustive contiguous-run search of invoices.csv's LPG invoice sequence (not just aggregate month totals) found a cent-exact partial-month split: doc 38846 (R7,337.97) = first 2 January-2025 invoices (39558+39714); doc 39812 (R20,557.69) = remaining 3 January invoices + all 3 February invoices. Combined they settle all of January + February 2025 (R27,895.66 = R17,574.84 + R10,320.82) exactly -- not orphaned cash. CYL-adjusted combinations were checked and not needed (cylinder_transactions.csv shows the deposit/return pairs net to ~R0 every cycle in this window). Applied the fix directly to monthly_lpg_insights.csv (Jan/Feb 2025 moved UNPAID -> FULLY_SETTLED, both docs recorded as refs). This does not resolve the separate doc 40746/44555 June-vs-July / Mar-2026-vs-Dec-2025 dispute, which remains UNRESOLVED -- it is a different pair of payments in an adjacent window. NOTE: this entry originally (incorrectly) claimed the pre-2021 orphaned-cash total dropped from R54,902.41 to R27,006.44 -- that was an arithmetic error, corrected in the next entry. The 38846/39812 pair was never part of that R54,902.41 figure; the two groups were always separate.

Tried the same contiguous-run search on the remaining 14 pre-2021 orphaned payments (R54,902.41, unchanged from original -- see correction note in prior entry). Does NOT resolve, for principled reasons: (1) ambiguous/duplicate matches -- e.g. docs 7226 (2020-06-29) and 7489 (2020-09-04), months apart, both 'match' the identical invoice range, which is impossible for two real payments; (2) this era's invoice amounts are round multiples of a standard per-unit rate (R700.01, R1,400.01, R3,000, R5,000, etc.) that recur constantly, unlike Jan/Feb 2025's unique non-round sums; (3) a genuine ~10-month invoicing gap (Apr 2020-Feb 2021, no LPG invoices recorded at all) that a naive index-based search would otherwise silently bridge. Verdict: these 14 payments cannot be resolved by this method, consistent with SS0's applicability boundary (pre-STAT-batch era, round ad hoc on-account payments, not sums targeting specific invoices). Resolving them needs a period bank statement or bordereau, not further search over this dataset. Report SS6/SS9 updated; recommendation changed from 'keep searching' to 'do not re-search, different evidence needed.'

Two follow-ups after other work landed on main (a v4.1 workbook + a JIM001_Legal_Handoff_Investigation_Tasks.md checklist, both from elsewhere). (1) Found and fixed a real bug in analysis/debtors/JIM001/scripts/build_lpg_reconciliation_v41.py's resolve_payments(): it summed a referenced payment doc's FULL gross against every month that referenced it, double-counting doc 39812 (shared between Jan and Feb 2025) and producing misleading -R10,320.82/-R10,236.87 'Net less Gross' variances in the 'Open Invoices by Month' sheet. Added compute_doc_month_gross() to split a shared doc's gross across its months using each month's own (trusted) payment_total_allocated to solve solo-reference months directly, with the remainder going to the ambiguous month(s) -- verified against the only real shared-doc case in the dataset (39812), now correctly shows R0.00 variance for both Jan and Feb 2025. Non-shared docs (including genuine Rule-13 surplus cases like doc 16648) are unaffected -- verified no regression. Regenerated v4.1.xlsx from the fixed script. (2) Updated JIM001_Legal_Handoff_Investigation_Tasks.md: corrected its stale 'unpaid months' list (Jan/Feb 2025 were still listed as unpaid; they're resolved), documented the Jan/Feb 2025 finding, and added a definitively-checked (not just flagged) note that Apr/May/Jun/Dec 2025 and Jan/Feb/Apr/May 2026 have zero orphaned cash anywhere nearby (every unassigned payment in the dataset is pre-2021) -- these months are genuinely unpaid, not just uncaptured, unlike Jan/Feb 2025 was.

User supplied a raw ERP transaction export (DEBENQ enquiry screen, 'YEAR: CURRENT') -- saved to raw/DEBENQ_CURRENT.TXT. This is a genuine system-of-record pull, not a reconstruction: 272 transaction rows, internally perfect running balance (0 chain breaks), closing balance matches its own stated CURRENT BALANCE (R122,884.84) exactly. Findings: (1) DOC 40746 PROVEN AS JULY: its 6 raw ERP lines tag it against 4 full July-2025 invoices by real invoice number (44516/44707/44933/45091, R14,316.89) plus tiny boundary cleanups on a June invoice (43628, R262.54) and an August invoice (45323, R0.01) -- sums to R14,579.44 exactly. This is Tier 2 evidence (real ERP ledger, not Tier 1 remittance advice but no longer a reconstruction) -- upgraded from ASSERTED to PROVEN, the first PROVEN finding in this account. The allocation_edges.csv ERP_LEDGER/Probable rows that claimed June (AL-0337-AL-0340) do not correspond to anything in the real ERP at all. (2) DOC 44555 STAYS UNRESOLVED BUT MARCH-2026'S BASIS IS NOW CONFIRMED FICTITIOUS: its one raw ERP line has a BLANK INVNO field -- genuinely untagged to any invoice, contradicting allocation_edges.csv's AL-0359-AL-0361 claim that it splits across 3 named March-2026 invoices. That claimed split does not exist in the real ERP either. December-2025's aggregate-match reading is now the only one with any support, though still not proven. (3) SECOND BALANCE BRIDGE VALIDATED: the raw file is complete (0 missing invoice docs vs invoices.csv) only from 2025-03-01 onward -- before that it's a 'current activity' snapshot missing 420 of 620 invoice/CN docs (archived-out history, not a real gap). From 2025-03-01, the raw ERP's own net movement (R77,682.17, from its stated pre-window balance R45,202.67 to CURRENT BALANCE R122,884.84) ties to this repo's own LPG+CYL-invoiced-minus-cash-paid computation (R80,097.17) to within R2,415.00 -- a recognizable single CYL-deposit-unit-sized boundary artifact, not a systemic issue. 97% tie-out against the real ERP header balance, independent confirmation invoices.csv/payments.csv are sound for this window.
